name: Karn-Tor Warchief (CR 12)
body:
Karn-Tor Warchief
CR 12

XP 19,200
Karn-tor barbarian 6
NE Large monstrous humanoid (reptilian)
Init +3; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +13

DEFENSE

AC 21, touch 10, flat-footed 18 (+3 Dex, +11 natural, –2 rage, –1 size)
hp 201 (16 HD; 10d10+6d12+102)
Fort +15, Ref +12, Will +13
Defensive Abilities improved uncanny dodge, trap sense +2; ferocity

OFFENSE

Speed 50 ft.
Melee bite +23 (1d8+8), 2 talons +23 (1d6+8/19–20) or bite +23 (1d8+8), +2 chainsaw +26/+21/+16/+11 (3d8+14/15-20)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks rage (17 rounds/day), rage powers (animal fury, powerful blow +2, raging leaper +6), leaping charge, blood rage

Base Statistics

When not raging, a karn-tor warchief’s statistics are:

AC 23, touch 12, flat-footed 20; hp 169; Fort +13, Will +11; bite +21 (1d8+6), 2 talons +21 (1d6+6/19–20), or +2 chainsaw +24/+19/+14/+9 (3d8+11/15-20); Str 22, Con 17; CMB +23, CMD 36; Skills Climb +14, Swim +15.

STATISTICS

Str 26, Dex 17, Con 21, Int 10, Wis 14, Cha 8
Base Atk +16; CMB +25; CMD 36
Feats Cleave, Great Fortitude, Improved Critical (chainsaw), Improved Natural Armor, Power Attack, Stealthy, Toughness, Weapon Focus (chainsaw)
Skills Acrobatics +20 (+28 when jumping), Climb +16, Escape Artist +5, Intimidate +10, Knowledge (nature) +8, Perception +13, Ride +6, Stealth +18 (+22 in swamps), Survival +11, Swim +17; Racial Modifiers +8 Acrobatics when jumping, +4 Stealth in swamps
Languages Common, Karn-Tor
SQ fast movement
Gear +2 amulet of natural armor, Large +2 chainsaw
